ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45:55 ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels to low-intensity (black/dark-gray) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe: Large, contiguous high-intensity white region covering 85% of the surface area with a thin dark perimeter. Right lobe: Predominantly low-intensity dark surface with a distinct, high-contrast white patch on the lateral tip and sparse white mottling near the peduncle junction.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the trailing edges of both lobes; several distinct small-scale notches visible on the lateral-most margins.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edges tapering into a complex sigmoidal curve along the trailing edges, ending in sharp lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertical, low-contrast linear markings detected on the dark-pigmented surface of the right fluke lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized biological protrusions (barnacles) on the trailing edge tips; significant white scarring/pigmentation on the right lateral margin.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced pigmentation asymmetry; the left lobe is almost entirely white while the right lobe is predominantly black.
